summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5 (generated OpenAPI Swift client). Five permanent wiring tests fail by design: the package declares no swift-openapi-generator/runtime dependencies, no vendored OpenAPI document exists, and no OpenAPIGeneratedClient target is configured. Seven generated-client tests are #if canImport(OpenAPIGeneratedClient)-gated so the target still compiles today; they activate with the implementation. Six permanent server-response-contract tests pin the published upstream behavior (200-with-JSON upload bodies, composite patch ids, null title) and are green against the current hand-written client. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so no test could be executed locally; execution of record is swift test on the macOS CI runner. Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (13 findings incl. manifest under-documentation, measurement-stats omission, 200-vs-204 upload responses, printer_profile field renames, missing reference patches) are recorded in docs/openapi-generated-client-test-plan.md as PR-description source material.
